faq.title: Free unlimited audio to text — FAQ

items.q: Is EarScribe really 100% free with no limits?
items.a: Yes — 100% free, unlimited, no sign-up and no login required. There are no paid tiers, no credit card, no per-minute fees, and no daily or monthly quota. The Whisper speech to text model runs on your own hardware, so there is no cloud compute cost to pass on. Free audio to text with no strings attached.

items.q: Can I edit the transcript before exporting?
items.a: Yes. Open edit mode to correct names, quotes, numbers, or technical terms. The edited transcript is used for copy and every export format, and the draft is saved in this browser.

items.q: What does the subtitle check look for?
items.a: It flags empty, overly long, unusually fast, repeated, or overlapping cues. You can improve line breaks automatically, then listen through important sections before exporting SRT or VTT.

items.q: Why is the first run slow?
items.a: The first time you pick a model for audio to text, your browser downloads it (80 MB to 800 MB depending on the size). After that the free audio to text model is cached and reused — no re-download needed.
Free audio to text supports 99 languages via Whisper. The language is detected automatically — you do not need to pick one.
Not directly. For video audio to text, extract the audio first (any tool that can output MP3 or WAV will work) and drop that here.

items.q: Which Whisper model should I choose?
items.a: Start with the recommended balanced model. Use Tiny for a smaller download, Small for harder audio when your device has enough memory, or Turbo when you want the highest available accuracy on capable hardware.

items.q: How do I convert an MP3 to text for free?
items.a: Choose the MP3, keep the recommended quality setting, then review the timestamped transcript. Correct important details and copy the text or export SRT, VTT, TXT or JSON. No account is required.

items.q: Is there a free Otter.ai or Rev alternative?
items.a: EarScribe is useful when you want a free, no-account workflow for one recording: transcribe, search, replay timestamps, edit, check subtitles, and export. Hosted tools may be a better fit when you need shared team workspaces or managed collaboration.

items.q: Can I generate SRT or VTT subtitles from audio?
items.a: Yes. After audio to text, click Export → .srt or .vtt. Cue timing comes from Whisper's emitted timestamps, so the subtitles align with the audio to text output without manual splitting.

items.q: Does this run OpenAI Whisper in the browser?
items.a: Yes — EarScribe runs free audio to text via Whisper (Tiny, Base, Small, and Large v3 Turbo) directly in the browser through Transformers.js on WebGPU, falling back to WebAssembly when unavailable.

about.title: About EarScribe
about.intro: EarScribe turns recordings into searchable, timestamped transcripts and subtitles without putting account setup before the result.
about.noServer: The workflow starts with a recommended quality setting. Search, replay, and editing stay simple, while model comparison and subtitle checks appear only when you need them.
about.credits: Built on Transformers.js, ONNX Runtime Web and the open-source Whisper models from OpenAI.
about.operatorBody: EarScribe is a small independent project, built and maintained by one developer. It started in May 2026 to make transcription possible without uploading recordings or creating an account. The source code is public on GitHub, and advertising on the site helps keep it free.

footer.tagline: 100% free audio to text and speech to text. No sign-up, no login.
footer.builtWith: Built with Transformers.js, ONNX Runtime Web, Whisper.
